title: Fire a real cavern invasion and see whether v5.8's exclusion actually holds. Addendum 49 shipped the rule that DF's own invaders — invasion_id >= 0 — leave every layer count, because one raid can make a cavern look stocked and silence the job that keeps it alive. That rule has never met an invasion: none has fired in any run to date, so the exclusion has only ever been exercised against zero invaders. DF's shipped agitation-rebalance shows where the roll lives — each cavern's feature_init_subterranean_from_layerst carries feature.irritation_level, worth irritation/10000 of attack chance per season, capped at 100,000 — so one arm pins all three cavern features at 100,000 — re-pinned at every sample, after the count is taken, so DF cannot quietly decay the condition out from under the arm the way it decays outdoor irritation — and runs two seasons to guarantee a seasonal roll; the control leaves them where DF has them. The tool runs in both arms with the cavern layer managed and no ceiling, so the counts under test are the shipped ones. Two replicates each.
fork: Does a live cavern invasion leave the tool's layer counts, or does it inflate them and stall the cavern job.

predictions.expects: invaders appear on the map in the irritated arm, invaders>0 is logged, and the cavern count never counts them — cavern tracks the control while invaders climb

predictions.model: the exclusion is a silent no-op
predictions.expects: invaders appear and the cavern count rises with them, which means WILD.field resolved to false or to the wrong name on this build

predictions.model: irritation alone does not fire an invasion
predictions.expects: no unit ever carries invasion_id >= 0 despite both cavern features pinned at maximum for two seasons, which means the roll needs something else — a civ with a route, or wealth — and v6.1's cavern-raid module cannot be tested on this fort

kill_criterion: at least one invasion in the irritated arm with the cavern count provably excluding every invader, 2 of 2, validates the shipped exclusion; invaders counted as cavern wildlife is a v5.8 bug to fix before v6.1
culling: drop a replicate on any changed save
a replicate with zero invaders is not a failure of the exclusion — it is a failure of the trigger, and is reported as such

arms.name: cavern_irritated
pre: local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local cfg=sw.loadConfig(); if not cfg.initialized then sw.captureDefault(cfg) end; cfg.layers.land=true; cfg.layers.water=false; cfg.layers.cavern=true; local pool=sw.buildPool(cfg); local n=0; for _,e in ipairs(pool) do if e.inEmbark and sw.defaultAllow(e) then cfg.allow[e.key]=true; n=n+1 end end; local a=sw.assignFromMatrix(cfg,pool); cfg.groups.enabled=true; cfg.groups.coupling=false; cfg.ecology.enabled=false; cfg.quota.cavern=0; sw.saveConfig(cfg); sw.applyLive(cfg, df.global.cur_season); sw.saveConfig(cfg); sw.enableSched(); print(('e23b: roster %d allowed, %d assigned; cavern layer managed, no ceiling'):format(n,a))

local mf=df.global.world.features.map_features; local set,parts=0,{}; for _,f in ipairs(mf) do if df.feature_init_subterranean_from_layerst:is_instance(f) then f.feature.irritation_level=100000; set=set+1; parts[#parts+1]=('depth%d=%d'):format(f.start_depth,f.feature.irritation_level) end end; local cd=df.global.plotinfo.main.custom_difficulty; print(('e23b: %d cavern features pinned at 100000 (%s); cavern_dweller_max_attackers=%d forgotten_irritate_min=%d'):format(set,table.concat(parts,' '),cd.cavern_dweller_max_attackers,cd.forgotten_irritate_min))

local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local by=sw.WILD.countByLayer(); local cz,inv=0,0; local mix={}; for _,u in ipairs(df.global.world.units.active) do if dfhack.units.isCitizen(u) and not dfhack.units.isDead(u) then cz=cz+1 end end; for _,u in ipairs(df.global.world.units.active) do if not dfhack.units.isDead(u) and not u.flags1.inactive and sw.WILD.invader(u) then inv=inv+1; local c=df.creature_raw.find(u.race); local t=c and c.creature_id or '?'; mix[t]=(mix[t] or 0)+1 end end; local ks={}; for k in pairs(mix) do ks[#ks+1]=k end; table.sort(ks); local parts={}; for _,k in ipairs(ks) do parts[#parts+1]=k..' x'..mix[k] end; local irr=0; for _,f in ipairs(df.global.world.features.map_features) do if df.feature_init_subterranean_from_layerst:is_instance(f) then irr=irr+f.feature.irritation_level end end; print(('e23b: land=%d cavern=%d deep=%d invaders=%d field=%s invader_mix=%s irritation_sum=%d citizens=%d day=%d'):format(by.land,by.cavern,by.deep,inv,tostring(sw.WILD.field),#parts>0 and table.concat(parts,', ') or 'none',irr,cz,math.floor(df.global.cur_year_tick/1200)))

local mf=df.global.world.features.map_features; local set=0; for _,f in ipairs(mf) do if df.feature_init_subterranean_from_layerst:is_instance(f) and f.feature.irritation_level<100000 then f.feature.irritation_level=100000; set=set+1 end end; if set>0 then print(('e23b: re-pinned %d cavern features back to 100000'):format(set)) else print('e23b: cavern irritation still at 100000, nothing to re-pin') end
